properties.title: Ratko Mladić, ‘butcher of Bosnia’, dies at the Hague aged 84
properties.summary: Ratko Mladić, the former Bosnian Serb military commander who was the architect of the 1995 Srebrenica massacre during the Bosnian War, has died aged 84, according to Serbian state media . The war criminal was serving a life sentence at The Hague for crimes against humanity, war crimes and genocide. “Ratko Mladić is dead, and there’s not much to say about it.
